Thought: To solve this problem, I need to determine the hybridization of the oxygen atoms in the molecule 3-amino-1-phenylpropan-1-ol. First, I will analyze the structure of the molecule based on its name.

1. "3-amino-1-phenylpropan-1-ol" indicates:
   - A 3-carbon chain (propan)
   - An amino group (-NH2) on the third carbon
   - A phenyl group (C6H5) attached to the first carbon
   - An alcohol group (-OH) on the first carbon, as "1-ol" indicates an alcohol.

2. The oxygen in the alcohol group typically has a sp3 hybridization because it forms two sigma bonds (one with carbon and one with hydrogen) and has two lone pairs.

Therefore, the oxygen atom in this molecule is sp3 hybridized.
